title: fix(ui): offload large diff highlighting to a worker
description:
## Summary

- offload eligible interactive large-diff syntax highlighting to one Bun worker while retaining the existing HAST row pipeline
- bundle the worker in compiled Hunk binaries and keep static/headless commands on their existing paths
- fall back to plain text if the worker fails, without re-running the expensive highlight on the terminal event loop

## Validation

- `bun run typecheck`
- `bun test src/ui/diff/diffRows.test.ts test/pty/highlighting.test.ts`
- `bun run build:bin`
- `HUNK_TEST_EXECUTABLE=dist/hunk bun test test/pty/highlighting.test.ts test/cli/compiled-headless-native-lib.test.ts`
- `bun run test:integration`
- `bun run test:tty-smoke`

*This PR description was generated by Pi using gpt-5.6-sol*

bugs.summary: The entrypoint now statically imports disposeHighlightWorker from the ui/diff/worker barrel, which re-exports the compact-payload and HAST modules that import @pierre/diffs at runtime, so every command (hunk --version, --help, daemon serve, markup, hunk session *) eagerly loads the diff engine again (~100 ms), breaking the startup-deferral contract the dynamic imports exist for. The matching finally { disposeHighlightWorker() } around runInteractiveApp is also wrong: runInteractiveApp returns once the app is mounted, so it disposes nothing and the worker is never released at app shutdown.
bugs.trigger: Run any headless command such as hunk --version or hunk session list: src/main.tsx's eager import graph reaches src/ui/diff/worker/index.ts -> highlightCompact.ts -> highlightHast.ts -> @pierre/diffs before the command is dispatched.
